title: No Room at the Inn
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Caesar, a great ruler, made a rule. Everyone had to go to their family’s home town to be counted.
Joseph’s family came from Bethlehem, King David’s town. So Joseph and Mary went from Nazareth to Bethlehem. Mary’s baby was almost ready to come.
Bethlehem was very full. There was no room for them in the inn, where travelers stayed.
p2: In Bethlehem, baby Jesus was born. Mary wrapped Him in soft cloths. She laid Him in a manger, the hay box animals eat from. It was a humble bed for the King of the world.
Jesus came in a simple, quiet way, close to everyone. Tonight, snuggle up and thank Heavenly Father for your cozy place.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
